🏭 One year after investing in ECI Systems,

Coimbatore—here's a ground-level update. When the company was raising capital, the plan was clear: acquire land and set up a powder coating facility (Unit 2). That was the investment thesis.

📍 Latest status from the visit:

⚡ The powder coating facility is ready and waiting only for the electricity department’s power connection. Once live, it should improve margins and give full control over product quality and finish.
⚙️ shop floor is running at full capacity — a clear step-up in activity versus last year.
🤝 In the past 12 months, ECI has onboarded several new domestic and international customers.
🛠️ Capex completed on wire harness equipment, plate processing centre, and laser cutting machine.
👥 Headcount has risen from 142 to 189, with another 25 hires planned over the next three months.
📋 Currently undergoing an audit by a large MNC for a specific licence. Approval should further support top-line and bottom-line growth.
Execution is visible on the ground.

Looking forward to the next phase for @eci_systems. Hopefully, we’ll see the company in the public markets soon. Wishing @senthilkumardevadass and the entire ECI Systems team all the best! 👏

Traffic Challan పై 50-80% Discount?

December 12 Lok Adalat — Is the 50–80% Traffic Challan Discount Real?

A message claiming that pending traffic challans can be paid at a 50–80% discount during the December 12 Lok Adalat is circulating on social media. Before you pay a reduced amount or forward the message to someone else, how can you tell whether the offer is genuine?

In this Money Purse video, we play a traffic police officer’s response to the viral claim. We explain why a Lok Adalat date alone does not confirm a blanket discount on pending challans, where motorists in Telangana and Andhra Pradesh can check for official announcements, and how scammers can use discount messages to send fake payment links.

Before paying, open your state’s official traffic police website or the government e-Challan portal directly. Verify your challan details and the amount shown there, especially if a forwarded message promises a lower amount.

Share this video with someone who received the viral message, and subscribe to Money Purse for more Telugu fact-checks and consumer updates.

item.title: ▶ Ramu vs Somu: Who Is the Real Financial Winner?...
item.dc:creator: Money Purse · Instagram
item.description:
Ramu vs Somu: Who Is the Real Financial Winner?

₹743 a month vs ₹2,653 a month for the same ₹1 crore sum assured. What changed? Ramu bought term insurance at 25. Somu waited until 40.

Both friends started working at the same age. Ramu took out term life insurance when he was 25, while Somu put off the decision. By the time Somu looked for ₹1 crore of cover at 40, his illustrated monthly premium was ₹1,910 higher, around 3.6 times Ramu’s.

The story also shows what waiting meant beyond the monthly premium. Somu went 15 years without that term cover. If his family had depended on his income during those years, an unexpected death could have left them without that financial protection. Changes in health can also affect eligibility and the premium an insurer offers.

Watch the full reel to see how buying term insurance at different ages can affect both the premium you’re quoted and when your family’s protection begins.

Premiums are illustrative. Actual quotes and eligibility depend on factors such as age, health, tobacco use, policy term, plan features, and underwriting. Review the policy terms and your personalised quote before applying.

item.dc:creator: Money Purse · Instagram
item.description:
SIGMA Advanced Systems plant visit …

For his first interview, Kartheek Raju took us inside Sigma Advanced Systems in Sri City Planet.

We came to see what Sigma was building. We left with a bigger question.
What would it take for a company that makes aerospace components to build an entire aircraft?
In our recent Money Purse Know Your Company series, Kartheek Raju, Executive Vice Chairman of Sigma Advanced Systems, walked us through the company’s electronics and precision manufacturing facilities. These photos are from that visit.

On the factory floor, we saw some of the work Sigma does today. In the interview, Kartheek explained how he thinks about what comes next. What should Sigma build in-house? What capabilities can it gain through acquisitions? And once it buys a business, how does it bring that expertise into the group?

That led to one of the most interesting moments in the conversation. Kartheek said the capabilities Sigma is bringing together could allow it to build complete smaller aircraft.
Buying a company can give you a new capability. Bringing several teams and facilities together to build a single aircraft is a different challenge. That’s what I wanted to understand, and it’s the part of the conversation I’m most excited to share.

Thank you, Kartheek, for choosing Money Purse for your first interview and taking us onto the shop floor.

As disclosed in the episode, Know Your Company Series had no commercial arrangement with Sigma or its group companies for this interview.

IPO Investors కి Shock, Grey Market Premium Banned !

SEBI Update for IPO Investors | What the Grey Market Premium (GMP) Advisory Means

Should you use IPO Grey Market Premium (GMP) to predict listing gains? In its November 23, 2026 advisory, SEBI cautioned investors against relying on GMP to estimate an IPO’s listing price or expected returns. SEBI also advised registered intermediaries and market participants to stop publishing or sharing IPO GMP figures through websites, social media, email, SMS, and other channels. www.sebi.gov.in

In this Money Purse video, we explain what IPO GMP means, why it can be misleading, and what to check before applying for an IPO. We cover the company’s business model, management, balance sheet, and debt so you can make a more informed decision.
